j.title: Need help? Tell us where the next step breaks.

publish_evidence.caption:
NEED HELP? TELL US WHERE THE NEXT STEP BREAKS.

Email ersatzrealityenterprise@gmail.com. Send your country, city or region, preferred language, what you need, and whether a deadline is close. If you cannot call, write “email only.” If someone you know needs help, ask them to write to us or get their permission before sharing their story.

No U.S. hotline works everywhere. We will look for the relevant service *where you are*, show you the source and date, and help you form the next question. Then tell us what happened. If that door did not open, we keep looking for another route with you.

Need to post or sell something? Tell us what you make and where your post stalls. We can review the message and explore a digital product or store partnership together. No listing or money split happens until ownership, consent, price, costs and exactly who gets paid are agreed in writing.

Please do not send medical records, ID numbers, account details, court papers, or your exact sleeping location in the first email. We review messages manually; this is not an emergency service and no response time is guaranteed. If you need help right now, seek an established local emergency or aid service.

Naya Aven is the Director of Access and Follow-Through in our *EdereAirah simulation*. She shows how the question keeps moving. Earth replies come from us, with sources you can check—not from an imaginary caseworker. What should we look at with you first?

evidence_truth_model.historical_people: appearance, clothing, setting and artifacts evidence-grounded; uncertainty stays visible

approved_style_families.ALISTAIR_1898: Victorian oil-painting realism; hand-painted texture; visible canvas grain; soft diffusion; muted sepia-warm tones; no cinematic lighting, HDR or digital sharpness
approved_style_families.ER_ILLUSTRATED_DOCUMENTARY: soft stylized animated realism; expressive but grounded; warm textured tones; recognizable consistent likeness; natural proportions; not hyper-realistic; not exaggerated cartoon

j.rejection_rule: REJECT_NONCANON if output becomes generic Earth/stock/photoreal when a painted/illustrated family is locked; adds unexplained crowns, heraldry, symbols, props, furniture or modern signals; changes identity, complexion, proportions, wardrobe continuity, camera, room geometry, clue/evidence position or chronology; presents reconstruction as documentary evidence; uses floating branding where in-world embedding is locked; or moves to motion before the still scene is locked. Preserve the last approved scene and repair only the failed delta.
required_sequence: retrieve current backend HEAD and relevant visual canon before any visual work
declare phase: SCENE, MOTION, EXECUTION, or STRATEGY
state what the image is saying and what visible evidence/object/action makes it say that
define room orientation and all four walls when a room is visible
define floor and ceiling
define connected-room geometry and lighting continuity
define camera position/height/facing/frame/aspect ratio/distortion rule
define every character identity, position, facing, rotation limits, period clothing and chronology
define foreground/desk/table and every visible object
assign every visible object provenance, position, size, cause/history and FIXED or VARIABLE state
select approved visual treatment family; treatment cannot rewrite identity, geometry, chronology or evidence
for historical/evidence images separate documented evidence, reconstruction, inference and unknown
for motion decompose action into biomechanical units: angles, timing, weight shift, lead/follow, intent and recovery
run active visual and whole-scene multiplicative gates; any zero blocks generation
run contradiction, modern-contamination, generic-Earth, random-symbol and provenance checks
obtain Chairman approval where required
generate/edit only after pass
inspect rendered pixels against locks; reject drift rather than propagate it
j.generation_allowed_rule: GENERATION_ALLOWED only when the visible-scope scene contract is complete, every visible element has provenance or is an explicitly authorized variable texture, the approved treatment family is named, evidence/reconstruction boundaries are explicit, and all applicable multiplicative gates are nonzero. Interior scenes require wall/floor/ceiling/camera/connected-space definition. Motion requires a locked still identity/scene plus biomechanical motion units. Backend rules do not prove pixel compliance; rendered output must be inspected again before approval/publication.
